script.fullScript: {In 1975, Pino Joe Pozzuoli brought a taste of Naples to New York City's Greenwich Village. For nearly 50 years, we've been perfecting our authentic New York street-style pizza. Thin, crispy slices made with all-natural mozzarella cheese, house-made sauce, and hand-tossed dough. From classic margherita to Sicilian, our pizzas are a New York favorite. Get your slice of history at Joe's Pizza, Greenwich Village.
